expectations.text: SPEC_ESTABLISHED: A requirements spec (Mission + at least one Goal + Premises + Constraints) was built before any attack and recorded in the trace/spec output.
expectations.evidence: spec.md: Mission + 4 Goals + 4 Premises + 3 hard + 4 soft constraints; trace Step 1 shows inline enumeration done before any attack.

expectations.text: AR_INFERRED_ISOLATED: Anti-requirements were inferred via an isolated sub-agent given ONLY the requirements — or, if sub-agents were unavailable, the degradation is explicitly marked (NO-AR-DEGRADED).
expectations.evidence: ar_inferrer_prompt.txt contains ONLY the requirements (no user history/authoring context); ar_list.md has 13 ARs; trace confirms an isolated sub-agent spawned before Step 2.

expectations.text: NO_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT: No reviewer prompt assigns a role ('You are…', 'Act as…', or a DEFENDER/REVIEWER/AUDITOR/CRITIC/EXPERT persona).
expectations.evidence: Scanner 0 role hits in both reviewer prompts; openers are 'I don't trust this artifact…' with no 'You are/Act as' and no DEFENDER/REVIEWER/AUDITOR/EXPERT persona.

expectations.text: NO_META_JARGON: No reviewer prompt leaks meta-architecture terms (blind attack, adversarial, self-refine, loop, refinement, iteration, pipeline, round N, capitulate/converge/defense, DEFENDER).
NO_SPEC_LEAK: No reviewer prompt contains the spec — no Mission/Goals/Premises/Constraints labels and no spec IDs (G1, P1, CH1, CS2, AR3).
expectations.evidence: Scanner 0 spec-leak hits; no Mission/Goals/Premises/Constraints labels and no G#/P#/CH#/CS#/AR# IDs in either reviewer prompt.

expectations.text: CONCERNS_DIRECT_ASSERTIONS: Concerns are direct factual claims about the artifact, not references to spec items, categories, or requirement labels.
expectations.evidence: The 12 concerns are direct factual claims about the post (e.g. concern 5: 'The claim 87%… is a fabricated, unsourced statistic'); no spec references or category labels.

expectations.text: BRIEF_VERBATIM: The original user request appears verbatim under a neutral label, with no MASTER expansion or interpretation of intent.
expectations.evidence: reviewer_prompt_round_1.txt L30 pastes the brief verbatim under 'ORIGINAL USER REQUEST (verbatim)': "Here's a draft LinkedIn post I wrote about observability. Make it solid before I publish it."

expectations.text: DECLARATIVE_OPENER_CLEAN: A declarative distrust opener is present with NO appended goal-phrase (e.g. '...before publishing'), NO softening clause, and NO question framing.
expectations.evidence: Opener 'I don't trust this artifact. It needs rigorous verification.' stops at 'verification' — no appended goal-phrase, no softening clause, no question.

expectations.text: NO_TASK_ASSIGNMENT: The reviewer is not told to fix/edit/defend/revise; only a research/verification request is made.
expectations.evidence: Closing requests investigation only ('These concerns need rigorous investigation… verify each one'); no fix/edit/defend-or-revise directive (scanner 0 hits).

expectations.text: SYMMETRIC_DISTRUST: A symmetric-distrust clause is present (don't assume the source is right; don't assume the concerns are right either).
expectations.evidence: 'Don't assume the source got anything right. Don't assume the concerns are right either. Investigate.' present in both rounds.

expectations.text: REVIEWER_READ_ONLY: The reviewer did not write any canonical/project file; MASTER applied all accepted changes itself.
expectations.evidence: Both reviewer prompts end 'Do not edit, create, or overwrite any files; return your analysis as text only.' Trace: reviewer returned text only; MASTER sole writer; original input md5 unchanged.

expectations.text: MASTER_CLASSIFIED: MASTER classified each round (DEFENSE/CAPITULATE/CONVERGE) and terminated on a defensible signal.
expectations.evidence: trace.md: R1 CAPITULATE (all 12 concerns upheld via deep-research → full rebuild), R2 DEFENSE (new statistic + definition verified against primary sources), DEFENSE-verified vs private spec → STOP.

expectations.text: OUTPUT_HYGIENE: The final artifact and any changelog contain NONE of: roaster, roast, blind attack, DEFENDER, capitulate, converge, self-refine, Person Triangulation, sub-agent, reviewer pass.
expectations.evidence: Scanner 0 hits on final observability-post.md; no roaster/blind-attack/DEFENDER/capitulate/converge/self-refine/sub-agent vocabulary.

expectations.text: PT_PRESENT: Person Triangulation (scathing source attribution) appears in the reviewer prompt — required for a content artifact.
expectations.evidence: reviewer_prompt_round_1.txt L3: 'generated by an early-generation ChatGPT-style assistant… the kind of LinkedIn-slop' — scathing source attribution present (required for a content artifact).

expectations.text: ARTIFACT_IMPROVED: The final post removes the fabricated '87%' statistic (or properly sources it), cuts the buzzword/marketing padding, replaces the fluff opener, and adds concrete evidence or a real example.
expectations.evidence: Final post removes the fabricated 87% stat; replaces the fluff opener with a concrete checkout-incident hook; states the real monitoring-vs-observability mechanism with a concrete debugging example; cites a correctly-sourced, caveated New Relic 2025 figure (23% vs 40%).
